abstract: Removed the hardcoded `password: changeme` LXC default from ansible/vars/homelabinfra-defaults.yml so default LXC containers are created with SSH-key access only and no shared root password.
details: Deleted the single line `      password: changeme` (was line 12) nested under `homelabinfra_defaults.proxmox.lxc`. The `proxmox.lxc` subtree now flows directly from `disk_volume` (storage/size children intact) to `cores: 1` and retains all remaining keys: disk_volume, cores, description, features, memory, onboot, tags — no null/empty subtree introduced (AC1, AC2). No other line, file, example, or task was touched; the `lxc_module_keys` allowlist in tasks/proxmox/lxc-create.yml still lists `password`, so a user who explicitly sets proxmox.lxc.password in their own config/apps/<instance>.yml still has it forwarded to the module (AC4). With the default gone and no user override, `homelabinfra_instance.lxc` carries no `password` key, the allowlist intersection omits it, and the module is invoked with the required `pubkey` (ssh_public_key, asserted at lxc-create.yml:7) and no `password`, yielding key-only root SSH (AC3). Verification: the lint gate (ansible-lint profile min) passes exit 0 on the touched file (V1/AC5); grep for `password` in the edited file returns zero matches (V3). The test gate (ansible-playbook --syntax-check over every playbook) exits 1, but exclusively from four pre-existing failures in unrelated playbooks — role 'docker' not found (create-docker-host.yml), 'instance' is undefined (restart-app.yml, tail-applog.yml), and empty playbook (rollback-container.yml). I confirmed these four errors are identical on the base file state by stashing the edit and re-running the gate: the failure set is unchanged, none reference the edited defaults file, and every playbook that actually loads homelabinfra-defaults.yml (bootstrap.yml, apps, proxmox/create-lxc.yml) syntax-checks clean. The edited defaults file therefore still parses and loads (V2 intent satisfied); the gate's non-zero exit is a pre-existing repository condition outside this change's blast radius, not a regression from this edit.

[ERROR]: Error processing keyword 'hosts': 'instance' is undefined (playbooks/maintenance/tail-applog.yml:12)
[ERROR]: Empty playbook, nothing to do: playbooks/stacks/rollback-container.yml
All other playbooks (including bootstrap.yml, apps, proxmox/create-lxc.yml which load homelabinfra-defaults.yml) syntax-check clean. Verified identical failure set on base state: `git stash push ansible/vars/homelabinfra-defaults.yml` then re-ran the gate — same four [ERROR] lines, same exit 1 — proving this edit introduces no new failure and the edited defaults file still parses/loads.
